title: Estimation of Absolute Protein–DNA Binding Free Energy using Streamlined Geometric Formalism
authors: Shreya Mukherjee; Diship Srivastava; Niladri Patra
one_liner_zh: 该文用简化的几何形式主义计算蛋白-DNA复合物的绝对结合自由能，聚焦蛋白-DNA互作机制，方法为物理模拟，虽非典型TF-DNA体系但高度相关。
abstract: Protein-DNA complexes are involved in vital cellular functions like gene regulation, replication, transcription, packaging, rearrangement, and damage repair. In this work, streamlined geometric formalism for computing the absolute binding free energy was used to obtain chemical accurate in silico estimation of binding free energy of three Protein-DNA complexes. Additionally, molecular interactions between Protein and DNA involved hydrogen bonds, electrostatic, van der Waals, and hydrophobic interactions. Using this formalism, researcher can obtain the absolute binding free energy for a Protein-DNA complex with remarkable accuracy and modest computational cost.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质-DNA复合物参与基因调控、复制、转录、包装、重排及损伤修复等关键细胞功能。本研究采用简化的几何形式主义计算绝对结合自由能，以化学精度对三种蛋白质-DNA复合物的结合自由能进行了计算机模拟估算。此外，蛋白质与DNA之间的分子相互作用涉及氢键、静电、范德华力和疏水相互作用。利用这一形式主义，研究者能够以显著准确性和适度的计算成本获得蛋白质-DNA复合物的绝对结合自由能。
